newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh Jan-Sept trade surplus widens to $1.22 bln.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh Jan-Sept trade surplus widens to $1.22 bln.

text.p: Kazakhstan posted a trade surplus of $1.22 billion in the first nine months of this year after a $1.05 billion surplus in the same period of 1995, the State Statistics Committee said on Monday.
KAZAKH MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Sept 96 Jan-Aug 96 Jan-Sept 95
NOTE - Figures in billion dollars. Differences due to rounding. Data are for trade with "far abroad" excluding former Soviet states. The surplus including former Soviet republics was $1.75 billion.
